completion_promises.criterion_text: CapabilitiesRegistry Protocol declared with all four methods + correct return types.
completion_promises.evidence: src/jarvis/infrastructure/capabilities_registry.py declares CapabilitiesRegistry as @runtime_checkable Protocol with snapshot()->list[CapabilityDescriptor], async refresh()->None, async subscribe_updates(callback)->None, async close()->None. Verified by TestAC001ProtocolShape.test_protocol_has_required_methods (checks all four method names) and isinstance() checks on both Live and Stub instances.

completion_promises.criterion_text: LiveCapabilitiesRegistry.create(client, cache_ttl_seconds=30) returns a usable instance; first snapshot() triggers a fresh KV read; subsequent reads inside cache_ttl_seconds return the cached list.
completion_promises.evidence: create() classmethod calls _resolve_registry() then awaits an initial _force_refresh() so first snapshot() reflects fresh KV data. refresh() guards on (now - cache_loaded_at) < cache_ttl_seconds to skip re-reads inside the TTL window. Verified by TestAC002CacheTTL: test_create_warms_cache_with_first_kv_read (1 KV read after create), test_refresh_within_ttl_does_not_reread_kv (no extra reads in 3 refresh calls), test_refresh_with_zero_ttl_always_rereads.

completion_promises.criterion_text: KV-watch callback invalidates the cache — next snapshot() re-reads.
completion_promises.evidence: _watch_loop() consumes the KV watcher async iterator, calls _force_refresh() (TTL-bypassing) on every non-sentinel update, then fires the user callback exactly once. Verified by TestAC003KVWatchInvalidation.test_kv_watch_event_triggers_refresh which pushes a KV event and confirms snapshot reflects new data + callback fires once. test_history_complete_sentinel_is_skipped confirms None sentinel does not trigger refresh.

completion_promises.criterion_text: snapshot() returns a fresh list copy — mutating the result does not affect the cache.
completion_promises.evidence: snapshot() returns list(self._cache) constructing a new list per call. Verified by TestAC004SnapshotIsolation.test_snapshot_returns_fresh_list_copy: clears + appends to first snapshot, asserts second snapshot still has the original 2 entries with correct agent_ids and that the two snapshot lists are not the same object. Stub side has parallel test in TestAC007StubFallback.test_snapshot_returns_fresh_copy.

completion_promises.criterion_text: subscribe_updates(callback) — calling more than once per session is idempotent (no double-subscription, no double-fire).
completion_promises.evidence: subscribe_updates() guards on self._subscribed early-return so a second call does not open a second watcher and does not replace the callback. Verified by TestAC005SubscribeIdempotent.test_second_subscribe_call_is_noop which counts _resolve_watcher invocations (must be 1) and asserts the callback fires exactly once after a single KV change event (with a 50ms grace period to confirm no double-fire).

completion_promises.criterion_text: close() is idempotent; detaches the watcher; closes the underlying KV handle.
completion_promises.evidence: close() guards on self._closed early-return. First call cancels the watcher task, awaits cancellation, and calls watcher.stop() on the underlying KV watcher. Verified by TestAC006CloseIdempotent: test_close_cancels_watcher_task (watcher.stop_calls >= 1), test_close_is_idempotent (3 sequential close() calls, no exceptions), test_close_without_subscribe_is_safe (close before any subscribe is a clean no-op).
